cvStructure.issue: The CV has no dedicated Skills section listing tools and technologies, even though tools like Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, Git Hub Actions, Prometheus, and Grafana are mentioned only inside bullet points.
cvStructure.suggestion: Add a standalone 'Technical Skills' section grouping tools such as AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, Prometheus/Grafana, Ansible, and Bash so ATS systems can easily match them to job keywords.

keywordUsage.issue: The tool name 'Kubernets' is misspelled in the first Sadeem Cloud Services bullet point.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Correct the spelling to 'Kubernetes' so ATS keyword matching for this common DevOps tool works correctly.

keywordUsage.issue: The tool name 'Terrafrom' is misspelled in the VPC/RDS provisioning bullet point.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Correct the spelling to 'Terraform', which is also the subject of the listed HashiCorp certification.

keywordUsage.issue: 'Git Hub Actions' is written as two words instead of the standard product name 'GitHub Actions'.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Write it as 'GitHub Actions' to match the standard tool name recognized by ATS and recruiters.

readability.issue: The summary claims 'over 3 years of professional experience', but the Experience section only shows a 3-month internship (Jun-Aug 2025) and a current role starting Mar 2026, totaling less than a year.
readability.suggestion: Revise the summary to accurately reflect the actual duration of professional experience shown in the Experience section.

readability.issue: The Cloud Operations Intern bullets ('Monitoring', 'Server stuff and deployments', 'Helping with tickets') are vague sentence fragments without action verbs or measurable results.
readability.suggestion: Rewrite these as full bullet points starting with action verbs and include specifics, similar to the strong 'Wrote a Bash script...' bullet already in that role.

readability.issue: The graduation project description ('I worked on the servers part with my team and it was successful') is vague and lacks technologies used or measurable outcomes.
readability.suggestion: Describe the specific server-related tasks performed, tools/technologies used, and any measurable result or impact of the project.

contentFormatting.issue: The 'Graduation project' entry has no date, while the other project entry ('Self-hosted Git server... 2025') includes one, creating inconsistent formatting.
contentFormatting.suggestion: Add a date or date range to the graduation project entry to match the formatting of the other project listed.
